mapper.sql: SELECT r.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atomic_requirement a WHERE a.requirement_id = r.id) AS atomic_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.test_case_id) FROM test_case_requirement_link l JOIN atomic_requirement a ON a.id = l.atomic_requirement_id WHERE a.requirement_id = r.id) AS test_case_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atomic_requirement a WHERE a.requirement_id = r.id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_case_requirement_link l WHERE l.atomic_requirement_id = a.id)) AS covered_atomic_count FROM requirement r
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_case_requirement_link l WHERE l.atomic_requirement_id = a.id) AS test_case_count FROM atomic_requirement a WHERE a.requirement_id = #{requirementId} ORDER BY a.id

SELECT l.atomic_requirement_id, tc.id, tc.tc_code, tc.title, tc.source, tc.review_status, tc.status FROM test_case_requirement_link l JOIN atomic_requirement a ON a.id = l.atomic_requirement_id JOIN test_case tc ON tc.id = l.test_case_id WHERE a.requirement_id = #{requirementId} ORDER BY l.atomic_requirement_id, tc.tc_code

SELECT a.id AS atomic_requirement_id, a.atomic_text, a.type, r.id AS requirement_id, r.req_code, r.title AS requirement_title FROM atomic_requirement a JOIN requirement r ON r.id = a.requirement_id WHERE r.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY r.req_code, a.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO requirement (project_id, req_code, title, description, source, priority) VALUES (#{projectId}, (SELECT CONCAT('REQ-', LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(req_code, 5) AS INT)), 0) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 3, '0')) FROM requirement WHERE project_id = #{projectId}), #{title}, #{description}, #{source}, #{priority})
